rows.notes: [T092] start_year 2013 re-confirmed by an open company source (was REPORTED tier after T031): LG Chem's own release of 2015-10-21 (S1) says the Holland plant 'began shipping lithium-ion batteries for the Chevy Volt in November 2013' (first commercial shipments; the release also gives groundbreaking July 2010, which is not a production date). Added step 2022 = 5 GWh/yr: InsideEVs 2022-03-23 (S2) reports the pre-expansion output as 5 GWh/yr, explicitly a 'we heard' estimate (not company-stated; basis press). The existing 2025 (21.5, T010: 16.5 LFP ESS + 5 NMC EV, Jun 2025) and 2026 (35, an earnings-call target, plan not production) steps are kept unchanged. NOT added: a 2018 step of 3 GWh from electrive 2018-01-06 ('Thanks to the fifth production line, production capacity shall climb to 3 GWh annually', line due Aug 2018) because it is a planned completion, not a dated in-production figure; the v1 capacity_timeline already carries it. No sourced step found for 2019-2021 (the 2018 line additions and the 5 GWh of 2022 imply 3-5 GWh but nothing dates them), so no interpolation.

[T092] CORRECTION of the existing ramp {2021:5, 2023:20}: the 2023 step (20 GWh = phase 1 5 + phase 2 15) is contradicted. Wuxi government 2024-08-05 (S4) says the phase-2 15 GWh plant building was only 'now going through completion-acceptance procedures' (竣工验收) and 'after completion can produce 15GWh', i.e. phase 2 was not producing in 2023 or at Aug 2024; the 2023 date was Wuxi's 2022 target (groundbreaking Feb 2022, 'expected in production in 2023' per T012). Series therefore keeps phase 1 only: 2021 = 5 GWh (design basis, EnergyTrend 2022-05-06, S3: 'first phase with 5GWh has been in operation since 2021'; year of 'since 2021' is the source's own). start_year 2021 now carries a quote (S3). Some outlets cite ~3 GWh actual initial output vs 5 GWh design (v1 timeline); not changed. Phase-2 production date (2025?) NOT found: no step added. If a later source dates phase 2 in production, add it then; the plan target stays only in nameplate/ref_year.

[T092] start_year 2023 (v1, reported) -> 2024 and step 2023:5 -> 2024:5 (design basis, phase 1 5 GWh cell + system-assembly lines). Feixi county government account (S5, 2026-10-06; year inferred from image path, the page shows only '10.06') states phase 1 (5GWh cell and system-assembly lines) 'was completed and put into production in 2024' and has ramped since; Pylontech's Sept-2025 announcement (S6, Sina/集邦 2025-10-09) confirms the 303-mu plant and 5 GWh cell/system line are built, remaining 5 GWh of equipment due by end-2026 (ready-for-use date moved to 2026-12). CONFLICT: v1 (CNR/Anhui 2023-04-21, page encoding garbled here, not quotable) expected plant No. 3 production from June 2023 and the original fundraising plan said 'built and in production 2024-02'; no open page I could read shows commercial 5 GWh production in 2023, so 2023 is not supported. The existing 2027:10 step is KEPT as found but is a plan step, not production: the company filing targets ready-for-use 2026-12 (see T023 notes) and nothing dates phase 2 in 2027; lead may drop it. 'Completed and put into production' is the government's retrospective wording; the AR 2025 table still shows the project as under construction (T023), so the 5 GWh is design capacity of the built phase, which may not be fully commissioned.
